about.title: Made in Portugal, by investors.
about.p1: BullValue was born from a simple frustration: there was no serious fundamental analysis platform in Portuguese. Tools were either expensive, English-only, or noise disguised as analysis.
about.p2: We are Bullocracy, a small team that believes Portuguese financial literacy deserves better than social media tips. That's why the essentials are free: SEC data, proper DCF and zero buy calls.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
faq.a1: Free includes the full S&P 500, 10 years of fundamentals, the DCF calculator, AI Brief (5 per day), curated theme lists, the earnings calendar and insider trading. Pro adds unlimited AI Brief and watchlists, saving DCF scenarios, CSV export, a private community and priority support.
faq.a2: No. BullValue is an analysis and education tool. No value, metric or insight is a recommendation to buy or sell. Decisions are always yours.
faq.a3: The 500 companies of the S&P 500. European coverage (including Euronext Lisbon) is on the roadmap.
faq.q4: Do the numbers match official filings?
faq.a4: Yes. Fundamentals come straight from official SEC EDGAR filings (10-K and 10-Q) and derived metrics (margins, ROIC, FCF) use standard, documented formulas. When a value doesn't exist we show N/A, we never make it up.
faq.q5: Can I try Pro and cancel?
faq.a5: Yes. Pro has a 7-day free trial and you can cancel anytime, no penalty. Payments are securely processed by Paddle.

about.title: Democratizing access to financial <italic>data.</italic>
about.intro: BullValue is a fundamental data analysis platform designed for all types of investors.

problem.title: Our Goal
problem.text: To give the individual investor easy, structured, and transparent access to corporate financial statements. By automating the extraction of complex SEC reports, we free up your time for what really matters: value analysis.

organization.title: The Bullocracy
organization.text: BullValue is built by The Bullocracy, an organization of young students seeking to democratize access to knowledge about Politics, Economics, and Investments. To achieve this, they create content on social media, from YouTube to TikTok, fostering a space for our community to write articles and opinions to be published online, on the website thebullocracy.com, where they stimulate free debate and financial literacy.

team.title: The Team
team.description: The entire platform is designed by people who understand and want to learn more about the markets, ensuring our tools reflect the real needs of fundamental analysis.

members.name: Rodrigo Martins
members.bio: Economics student at the University of Minho. Responsible for marketing strategy, site indexing, SEO, analytics metrics, and overall platform performance optimization, as well as the integration of BullValue into Bullocracy's content.

members.name: Tiago Costa
members.bio: Economics student at the University of Minho. Responsible for the conceptualization of the platform's ecosystem and features, defining the direction of tools, and focusing on product usability.

members.name: Alexandre Machado
members.bio: Student at IPCA (Polytechnic Institute of Cávado and Ave). Responsible for the technical development of the platform, designing the interface, and building the backend and frontend structure with a focus on code and software architecture.

philosophy.title: Data Philosophy
philosophy.text: Our analysis is based on mathematics and official reports extracted directly from the SEC. BullValue focuses on the solidity of numbers. We believe that financial decisions require clean data, technical precision, and transparency, characteristics we value deeply at BullValue.

contact.title: Official Contacts

compound.title: Compound Interest
compound.subtitle: Compound interest calculator to simulate your wealth growth.

tooltips.initialAmount: The capital you have available to allocate at the start of the simulation.
tooltips.monthlyContribution: The amount you plan to add regularly. Small consistent contributions maximize the exponential effect of compound interest.
tooltips.contribFreq: The frequency with which you will add new funds to the investment.
tooltips.contribTiming: Investing at the beginning of the period maximizes returns, since the capital spends more time in the market.
tooltips.years: The time horizon. Time is the mathematical variable with the greatest impact on the growth of Compound Interest.
tooltips.preset: Choose a fixed rate or a benchmark index. Indices auto-fill the rate with that market's historical average annualized return (CAGR) for the chosen window — price change only, excluding dividends.
tooltips.lookback: Sets the historical window used to estimate the index's annualized average return.
tooltips.interestRate: The projected annual return. Auto-filled with the historical CAGR when you pick a benchmark index; edit it freely for your own scenario.
tooltips.compound: The frequency with which the investment generates interest on accumulated profits. Stock market return is generally modeled with Annual compounding.

compound.disclaimer: Simulation for educational purposes only. Index returns are historical averages (price change, excluding dividends) and do not guarantee future results. This is not financial advice.

yieldCurve.title: Yield Curve (10Y - 2Y)
yieldCurve.description: The spread between 10-year and 2-year yields. An inverted curve (below zero) has historically been the market's most reliable recession warning.

fedFunds.title: Federal Funds Rate
fedFunds.description: The benchmark interest rate set by the Federal Reserve. It governs how easily money flows through the entire economy, driving cycles of expansion or contraction.

cpi.title: Inflation (CPI YoY)
cpi.description: The year-over-year percentage change in the Consumer Price Index. High inflation erodes purchasing power and forces central banks to raise rates, choking the economy.

gdp.title: GDP Growth (Real GDP YoY)
gdp.description: Real growth of the United States Gross Domestic Product. The definitive thermometer of the real economy.

unemployment.title: Unemployment Rate (US)
unemployment.description: The percentage of the US labor force that is unemployed. Rapid increases (the Sahm Rule) signal imminent danger.

vix.title: Volatility (VIX)
vix.description: The famous 'Fear Index'. It measures the market's expectation of 30-day volatility. Readings above 30 indicate widespread panic.
